summary.ja_easy: {会社|かいしゃ}に{雇|やと}われて{働|はたら}く{人|ひと}は、ふつう、{会社|かいしゃ}の{保険|ほけん}と{年金|ねんきん}に{入|はい}ります。パート・アルバイトは、{働|はたら}く{時間|じかん}などで{決|き}まります。{留学生|りゅうがくせい}は、{雇用保険|こようほけん}には{原則|げんそく}{入|はい}りません。{会社|かいしゃ}が{手続|てつづ}きをします（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。
summary.en: People regularly employed by a company that is covered by the system join its health insurance and employees' pension, regardless of nationality. For part-time workers, it depends on hours, days and the size of the company. If you are expected to work 31 days or more and 20 hours or more a week, you also join employment insurance. International students at a daytime school are normally not covered by employment insurance. The company does the paperwork (to be checked).

text.en: Part-time workers also join if their hours and days are at least 3/4 of a full-time worker's.
